description: Repairs r-wire/param-select-text: after a lone-surrogate value every later LongText value on the same QueryDef answered 0x800A0BF5, so later long values were never asked. On a read-write copy of r-wire-blank, for each r-wire cell of FText (Text(255)) and FMemo (LongText) a fresh temporary QueryDef PARAMETERS pV <type>; SELECT pV AS V FROM One; Parameters("pV").Value = Arg and read back, OpenRecordset(snapshot) with DBEngine.Errors read right after, the V field read; the QueryDef is closed before the next value. Asks the Parameter read-back and the V field tag, BSTR byte length and payload per value, or the error. Cells: FText empty, FText ascii, FText bmp, FText nul-middle, FText nul-only, FText astral, FText lone-high, FText lone-low, FText reversed-pair, FText u-fffe, FText odd-1-byte, FText odd-3-bytes, FText odd-3-bytes-high, FText len-255, FText len-256, FMemo empty, FMemo nul-middle, FMemo lone-high, FMemo lone-low, FMemo odd-1-byte, FMemo odd-5-bytes, FMemo len-300, FMemo len-5000, FMemo astral-4000, FMemo odd-8001-bytes
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
